environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in private subnet (no NAT gateway, no IGW attachment on subnet route table). Kafka connectivity provided exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint (AWS PrivateLink) with endpoint policy restricting principal to the task execution role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/stream-processor-task-role. The task's ENI is assigned a security group (sg-0xADMINBLOCK) that has NO inbound rules — only outbound to the VPC endpoint prefix list (pl-02cd2c6b) on port 9094. There is no load balancer, no service discovery entry, no Cloud Map registration, and no port mapping in the ECS task definition's network configuration exposes port 9090 externally. The VPC has no peering connections, no transit gateway attachments, and flow logs confirm zero ingress to the task ENI from any source other than the Kafka VPC endpoint.

config.network: private subnet, no IGW, no NAT, no peering, no TGW
config.port_mapping: no external port exposure in task definition
